purpose: Check a simple FP16/FP32 evolving-state reference before introducing extra decay machinery, under H-73/H-74.
assumptions: Positive isolated exponential decay; no input, recurrence, cancellation, noise or phase semantics.
Nearest ties-to-even storage rounding. Multiplication uses binary64 before the stated destination rounding.
Coefficient is either binary64 reference or rounded to the state format; these isolate different error sources.
Once an identical rounded state repeats, it is a fixed point of this input-free deterministic map, so subsequent iterations can be evaluated without repeating the multiplication.
Next-code event counts concern every representable transition of a normal positive scalar during a halving away from subnormal ranges.
An event per code is not required by a discrete-time model; multiple transitions between observation instants can be coalesced. Counts are arithmetic, not measured execution throughput.
No timestep, half-life, numeric format, scheduling algorithm or new data structure is adopted.
